newsitem.title: USA: U.S to sell $16 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills July 21.
newsitem.headline: U.S to sell $16 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills July 21.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $16 billion of three- and six-month bills on July 21 to raise $1.525 billion as a total of $14.479 billion of bills are maturing.

The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on July 24. The three-month bills mature on October 23 and the six-month bills mature on January 22, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127945R1 and for the six-month bills is 9127946B5.
